motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.css: .ds-attachment{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border,#e4e4ea);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#17171a);font:12px/1.6 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:260px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-attachment svg{flex:none;color:var(--muted,#62626c)}.ds-attachment span{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-attachment:hover,.ds-attachment:active{background:var(--soft,#e3f3ea)}.ds-attachment:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b7a40);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-attachment{transition:none}}

components.name: Learning card
components.description: The shared Android learning shell, with desktop sizing and follow-up action.
components.html:
学习讲解

结合图像、公式与操作理解概念。
components.css: .ds-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#17171a);border:1px solid var(--border,#e4e4ea);border-radius:18px;font:15px/1.6 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 12px 4px 18px}.ds-card-head>svg{color:var(--primary,#0b7a40)}.ds-card-head h2{margin:0;font-size:25px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-card-description{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted,#62626c);margin:0;padding:0 18px 12px}.ds-card-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border,#e4e4ea);padding:4px 12px}.ds-card-footer button{font:14px/1.6 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#62626c);min-height:48px;padding:10px 8px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-card-footer button:hover,.ds-card-footer button:active{background:var(--soft,#e3f3ea)}.ds-card-footer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b7a40);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card-footer button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
This app extends the existing Android learning interface. Neutral grey and chalk surfaces, ink text, the emerald W, and restrained rounded controls remain the visual identity. Windows system typography serves Chinese and English study material, while bundled textbook mathematics and highlighted code retain their own reading conventions. This is an app-scoped record of the implemented Windows extension, not a replacement identity for Android.

The source of truth is `src/style.css`, applied after `../android/learning-ui/src/style.css` by `src/main.tsx`. Shared learning renderers and their mathematics, code and explanation styles are imported through `src/Teaching.tsx`. Product intent is recorded in `../../PRODUCT.md`; this surface's composition is recorded in `SURFACE.md`. The `.review` captures show implemented structure, but captures made before the final action-color adjustment do not supersede current source tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral surfaces with emerald marks and actions.
Readable Chinese and English text, textbook mathematics, and code.
Rounded controls and thin separators with restrained functional depth.
Shared learning components retain their Android visual vocabulary.

rules.name: The Action and Mark Rule
rules.body: Keep the accessible action emerald separate from the graphic W emerald in light mode; do not substitute the logo color into normal-size action text or filled action controls.

rules.name: The Study Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the separate typography of prose, equations and code instead of flattening all three into app labels.

dos: Do preserve the Android neutral/chalk world and emerald W when extending Windows.
Do use the desktop action token for interactive text, focus and filled actions.
Do preserve separate reading treatments for prose, mathematics and code.
Do make keyboard focus and icon-button names visible or accessible as implemented.
Do keep overlay depth functional and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do retain the editable SVG and raster provenance when shipping icons.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity with a new desktop brand or display-font theme.
Don't promote chart, explanation or syntax colors into general app chrome.
Don't turn this surface's sidebar/composer composition into a rule for unrelated future screens.
Don't populate the intentionally empty Tools entry with invented student features.
Don't use pre-adjustment screenshots as authority for action-color tokens.
